replies.text:
Fixed. `words` split on every single space, so `"a b  c"` gave an empty word between the two spaces.

## What changed

- `src/lib.rs`: `split(' ')` became `split_whitespace()`, which also skips tabs and newlines.
- The test `splits_on_spaces` now passes.

```rust
pub fn words(text: &str) -> Vec<&str> {
    text.split_whitespace().collect()
}
```

> Note: leading and trailing spaces are dropped too, which the callers in this crate expect.
